supersedes: p1d5_host_preflight_report.json (which incorrectly reported voyage-4-nano and jina-v5-small as stable)
summary: After exhaustive testing with explicit model loading via lms CLI, the LM Studio host has exactly ONE operationally stable embedding model: text-embedding-qwen3-embedding-0.6b. All others crash, reload-loop, or are fake/mislabeled community uploads.
root_cause: LM Studio GGUF inference instability affecting all non-qwen3-arch embedding models. Bert-arch (BGE-M3, MiniLM) and nomic-arch models crash or enter reload loops when processing text longer than ~50 words (~550 chars). The qwen3-arch embedding model is immune. Additionally, several 'models' listed in LM Studio are community GGUF uploads misclassified as LLMs (type=llm) that share qwen3 architecture and produce identical embeddings to Qwen regardless of which is requested.

text-embedding-qwen3-embedding-0.6b.conclusion: OPERATIONALLY VIABLE — the only stable embedding model on this host

text-embedding-all-minilm-l12-v2.failure: model reload at ~50 words; crash at ~80 words

text-embedding-nomic-embed-text-v2-moe.failure: model reload loop under sustained load

voyage-4-nano.finding: Fake model — community GGUF upload by jsonMartin, classified as LLM, shares qwen3 architecture. Produces byte-identical embeddings to Qwen 0.6B. NOT the real Voyage-4-nano embedding model.
voyage-4-nano.conclusion: NOT A REAL MODEL — cannot serve as candidate C

jina-embeddings-v5-text-small-retrieval.finding: Mislabeled — shares qwen3 architecture, produces identical embeddings to Qwen. Likely a re-upload, not the real Jina model.

sprint_impact.candidate_C: DEAD — no materially different embedding model can run on this host
sprint_impact.sprint_structure: Two-way comparison: A (lexical) vs B (Qwen hybrid). A third candidate requires a different host or hosted API.

governing_principle: Preflight failure means operationally non-viable on this host. It does NOT mean the model is proven inferior. BGE-M3, MiniLM, Nomic, and the real Voyage/Jina models may all be strong — they cannot be evaluated on this LM Studio GGUF host.
